title: Hook
description: JSON Schema for a hook instance: a handler registered to fire on a named lifecycle event in the surrounding runtime. Structurally a positive-Π₁ closure rule.

fires-on.description: Slug of the lifecycle event this hook fires on.

payload-shape.description: Reference to the structure that shapes the event payload.

response-shape.description: Reference to the structure that shapes the response the runtime expects.

handler.description: Reference to the script the runtime invokes when the event fires.

installed-at.description: POSIX path the runtime reads to discover this hook.
